## ⭐ Selected (highest-conviction this run)

## Runners-up (considered, dropped this run)

1. **On-device GenAI evaluation / regression harness** — *Type D.* Apple shipped an Evaluations framework; ML Kit has a prose "evaluate prompt quality" page with no tooling behind it. **Dropped:** fails/marginal on platform-privilege gate (a small team can ship an eval harness as a Gradle dep).
2. **On-device safety / moderation classifier for user content** — *Type G.* 🕒 **High-priority regulatory clock** (minors law live Jan 2026; Play holds developers liable for generated output). **Parked:** tunability risk — one-size classifier may be unusable without heavy configuration; warrants its own run.
3. **On-device neural TTS developer API** — *Type A.* Biggest genuine whitespace (Google ships no modern TTS API; Picovoice sells Orca into the hole). **Dropped:** durability + feasibility weight — a large frozen-model commitment.
4. **Deferred / opportunistic inference scheduling** — *Type E.* "Run this batch when charging, on wifi, idle" under the shared system model. **Dropped:** thinner, more diffuse demand evidence.
5. **Reach tiering / graceful degradation across the fleet** — *Type F.* Converts the ~3.7% GenAI demo into a platform capability. **Dropped:** hard to make concrete without inventing per-tier quality numbers.
